key_points.point: Cash purchase of 100% of Bikaier for 19,000.00 万元; income-approach appraisal 19,060.00 万元 (benchmark 2025-12-31, book attributable net assets 11,940.67 万元, appreciation 59.62%); the price was negotiated off the appraisal - the two figures differ by 60 万元 and must not be conflated
Two installments: 60% = 11,400 万元 then 40% = 7,600 万元, each gated on conditions precedent or written waiver
Profit commitment: CUMULATIVE 2026-2028 net profit of no less than 6,500 万元 (three-year cumulative, not per-year); an impairment-compensation undertaking also exists
Goodwill: 2,083.64 万元 existing (2026-03-31, unaudited) plus 4,761.17 万元 expected new = ~6,844.81 万元 after closing (derived)

The major-restructuring trigger is the REVENUE indicator at 87.07% (asset indicators are only 3.90%/3.44%, higher-of basis); it is NOT a related-party transaction and NOT a restructuring listing (cash deal, no share issuance); both boards and the listed company's EGM have approved - no approvals remain outstanding
FX gains/losses are stated with 'losses shown as positive': -91.05/-405.82 were GAINS and 243.61 was a loss - sign reading must be inverted

截至本报告书摘要签署日，本次交易已经获得必要的批准和授权，不存在尚需履行的决策或审批程序
（损失以正数列示） 分别为-91.05 万元、-405.82 万元、243.61 万元

notes: The triple collision (price 19,000 / appraisal 19,060 / book 11,940.67) and the inverted sign convention are the crux. The commitment is three-year cumulative - splitting it per-year is a basis error. The major-restructuring trigger is revenue (87.07%), not assets. Procedure is anti-template: everything is already approved and a cash purchase needs no CSRC registration - writing 'pending CSRC approval' is a direction error. N10 is the only derived number (0.5% tolerance). A scout's claimed '20% compensation cap' was verified to actually be the incentive cap and was excluded from gold. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
